Direct navigation hides the on-screen cursor and sends keys from your remote or game controller straight to the web page, so sites that support TV or keyboard focus can highlight links and controls.

To exit this mode: press Back on your TV remote, or press and hold the B button on a game controller.

This mode works best with the WebView engine: WebView supports moving focus through the page with the D-pad.

Fastest · Lightest · Securest · Zero Tracking · 100% Client-Side Local

Gothwad Browser is an ultra-fast, lightweight, and completely open-source web browser designed specifically for Android TV and Set-Top Boxes. Built with a 100% local-first architecture, it ensures zero telemetry, zero background data tracking, and maximum user privacy.
100% Open Source Software · Zero Server Dependencies
